pdf_script = '''
import fitz  # PyMuPDF
from docx import Document

# Read the Word document
doc = Document("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.docx")
paragraphs = [p.text for p in doc.paragraphs]

# Create PDF with PyMuPDF
pdf = fitz.open()
page = pdf.new_page(width=595, height=842)  # A4

y = 50
margin_left = 50
max_width = 495
fontsize_title = 16
fontsize_normal = 10
line_height_title = 22
line_height_normal = 14

for para in paragraphs:
    if not para.strip():
        y += 10
        continue

    # Determine if this is a title/heading-like line
    is_title = para == "Customer Activity Report"
    is_heading = (not para.startswith(" ") and not para.startswith("Order") and
                  not para.startswith("Email:") and not para.startswith("Items:") and
                  "—" not in para and "|" not in para and
                  len(para) < 40 and para == para.strip() and
                  any(c.isalpha() for c in para))

    if is_title:
        fs = fontsize_title
        lh = line_height_title
        font = "helv"
    elif is_heading:
        fs = 12
        lh = 18
        font = "helv"
    else:
        fs = fontsize_normal
        lh = line_height_normal
        font = "helv"

    # Check if we need a new page
    if y + lh > 792:
        page = pdf.new_page(width=595, height=842)
        y = 50

    text_point = fitz.Point(margin_left, y)
    # Truncate long lines to fit page width
    page.insert_text(text_point, para, fontsize=fs, fontname=font)
    y += lh

pdf.save("/workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
pdf.close()
print("PDF created successfully at /workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf")
'''
